title: AI Highlights
subtitle: Drop in a long video and get the moments most worth turning into short clips.

source.label: Source video
source.hint: MP4, MOV and WebM; long videos are fine
source.noDesktop: AI Highlights requires the desktop app

options.openaiNoKey: Add an OpenAI key in Settings → API Keys to use this.
options.openaiUnavailable: OpenAI analysis is not available in this build.

privacy.local: Video and speech are processed on this computer and never uploaded.
privacy.openai: Only the transcript text is sent to OpenAI; the video is never uploaded.

empty.title: Turn long videos into short highlights
empty.body: AI listens to your video, then picks the strongest moments by tone, key phrases and pacing. Fine-tune them and add them to the editor in one click.
empty.step2: Pick a length and count, then press “Find highlights”
empty.step3: Tick the clips you like and add them to the editor

results.title: Highlights
results.noResults: No moments fit this length. Try another length.

actions.reframeTip: After adding, use “Auto Reframe” in the editor’s AI tab so the frame follows the subject.
actions.projectOpenTip: A project is open: clips are appended to the first video track and its aspect ratio stays unchanged.
